overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission regulates the sale, service, and licensing of alcoholic beverages in the City of Medford. The commission oversees permanent and temporary liquor licenses, approves operational and structural modifications, reviews police incident reports, and conducts disciplinary hearings for license violations. The archive covers seven meetings held between October 23, 2024, and September 16, 2026. At its most recent meeting, the commission approved multiple temporary licenses and permanent license amendments, and took under advisement a disciplinary hearing concerning alcohol service to a minor.

threads.name: One-day liquor licenses
threads.summary: The commission regularly reviews and votes on applications for one-day alcohol licenses for community, institutional, and private events across Medford. Approvals have covered events hosted by entities such as Medford Brewing Company, Arts Collaborative, Tufts University, and the City Hall Winter Extravaganza, frequently conditioned on the receipt of liquor liability insurance. Later meetings maintained approvals for community gatherings, church events, library events, and local festivals. At the most recent meeting, the commission authorized one-day licenses for multiple events including the Harvester Energy Festival, Oktoberfest, and library receptions.

threads.name: Disciplinary hearings and compliance enforcement
threads.summary: The commission conducts disciplinary proceedings and reviews incident reports concerning alleged liquor law violations and underage alcohol sales. In November 2024, following police testimony on underage sales, the commission ordered a 10-day license suspension and mandatory training for Medford Wine and Spirits, while clearing Razzo's Bar & Grill of violations following a separate police report review. In January 2025, the commission held a hearing on four allegations of underage alcohol sales at Main Street Liquors and took the matter under advisement. Most recently, the commission took under advisement allegations against the Great American Beer Hall regarding alcohol service and consumption by a 19-year-old minor.

threads.name: Permanent license transfers, renewals, and modifications
threads.summary: The commission manages permanent licenses through annual renewal cycles, transfers, category modifications, and surrender filings. Actions have included category changes for Desisto Enterprises, license transfers for Yoki X, Inc. and Mitsuba Sakaya Sushi Bar and Grill, and the accepted surrender of Chili Gardens' license. In December 2024, the commission approved the complete 2025 annual liquor license renewals across all classes and approved a new wine and malt license for Buns House in February 2025. In September 2026, the commission approved a change of location for Medford's Cappy's Inc. and premises alteration and license type changes for Medford Brewing Company.

threads.name: Entertainment licensing and operating hours
threads.summary: The commission reviews applications for entertainment devices and coordinates operating hours for licensed establishments. Early meetings addressed legal requirements and pending opinions for New Year's Eve hour extensions, conditional hours changes for Main Street Liquor, and entertainment permits for Snappy Patty's and El Tacuba. In February 2025, the commission approved television entertainment for Buns House and discussed streamlining common victualler operating hours with liquor service regulations. At the most recent meeting, hours and operational conditions continued alongside entertainment approvals.

threads.name: Ocean State Job Lot management change application
threads.summary: The commission repeatedly reviewed an application for a change of manager for Ocean State Job Lot. The item was first tabled in November 2024 because the applicant was unattended. In January 2025, the commission tabled the matter once again due to the applicant's absence. In February 2025, the item was skipped for a third time because no representative appeared to testify on behalf of the application.
